settings.title: Shifts
settings.subtitle: Where shifts happen and how people are asked to confirm them. Every change saves right away.

locations.title: Locations
locations.lead: Each location keeps its own time zone, so a shift reads the same for everyone no matter where they open it from.
locations.name: Name
locations.managerHint: Can schedule this location even without the Manage shifts permission.
locations.deleteBody: This location has never been scheduled, so nothing else is affected.
locations.emptyBody: Add the places your team works at: a lab, a branch, a warehouse.
locations.timezoneLocked: The time zone can't change once the location has shifts.
locations.planLimit: Your plan includes {{count}} active location. Upgrade to Growth for unlimited locations.
locations.planLimitReached: You've reached your plan's active location limit. Deactivate one or upgrade to Growth.

confirm.title: Confirmations
confirm.lead: How people find out about their shifts.
confirm.require: Ask people to accept or decline each shift
confirm.requireHint: When off, published shifts count as confirmed right away.
confirm.remindDayBefore: Remind people the day before their shift
confirm.dailyHint: Reminders go out once a day, in the morning.

rules.title: Scheduling rules
rules.lead: Checked every time someone is assigned. Breaking a rule shows a warning; the scheduler can still go ahead.
rules.minRest: Minimum rest between two shifts of the same person
rules.lateAfter: A clock-in counts as late after

templates.title: Shift templates
templates.lead: Saved start and end times that fill in a new shift with one click. Create them from the shift form.
templates.empty: No templates yet. In the shift form, use “Save these times as a template”.
templates.name: Name

skills.title: Skills and certifications
skills.lead: What a shift can require, and who holds each one. If someone is missing a required skill, or theirs has expired, the scheduler sees a warning when assigning them.
skills.growthOnly: Skills are part of the Growth plan.
skills.name: Skill
skills.emptyBody: Add the certifications or abilities your shifts need.

timesheet.title: Timesheet and cost
timesheet.lead: Weekly hours: everyone confirms theirs, their manager approves them.
timesheet.reminder: Remind people about yesterday's shift hours they haven't logged
timesheet.costHint: Hours × each person's hourly rate from Payroll. Only people with Payroll access see it.
timesheet.costGrowth: Schedule cost is part of the Growth plan (it uses Payroll rates).

swaps.title: Changes between people
swaps.lead: People can take free places on open shifts, hand their shift to whoever covers it, or swap with a colleague.
swaps.allow: Let people hand over and swap their shifts
swaps.swapApproval: Hand-overs and swaps need a scheduler's approval
swaps.openApproval: Taking a free place on an open shift needs a scheduler's approval
swaps.hint: When someone coming in has a warning (rest, availability, time off, skills), a scheduler always approves it.

warnings.time_off: Has approved time off that day
warnings.holiday: It's a day off on the company calendar
warnings.unavailable: Said they're unavailable at that time
warnings.outside_availability: Outside the hours they said they're available
warnings.rest: Less than the minimum rest from another shift

blocks.no_user: Needs a Northstack login to get shifts
blocks.overlap: Already has a shift at that time

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Plan the week, then publish to let everyone know.
schedule.copyConfirmTitle: Copy last week into this one?
schedule.copyConfirmBody: Every shift from {{range}} is added to this week as a draft, with the same people. Nothing is sent until you publish.
schedule.copiedSkipped: {{count}} shifts copied as drafts. {{skipped}} people were left off because they already have a shift then or no longer have a login.
schedule.publishConfirmBody: Everyone on these shifts gets a notification and an email to confirm.
schedule.noLocationsBody: Shifts happen at a location. Set up where your team works in Settings → Shifts.
schedule.published_one: Published {{count}} shift. Everyone on it was notified.
schedule.published_other: Published {{count}} shifts. Everyone on them was notified.
schedule.clickToAdd: Click to add a shift here

form.saveTemplate: Save these times as a template
form.reconfirmWarning: Changing the date, time or location asks everyone on this shift to confirm again.
form.requiredSkillsHint: People without them (or with them expired) show a warning when assigned.

detail.deleteBody: Nobody was told about it, so nothing else happens.
detail.cancelBody: Everyone on it gets a notification and an email, and it's removed from their calendar.
detail.draftHint: Draft: nobody has been notified. Publish it when it's ready.

mine.title: My shifts
mine.subtitle: Your upcoming shifts. Let your team know if you can make each one.
mine.empty: You have no shifts in the next 4 weeks.
mine.accepted: Shift confirmed. Your manager can see it.
mine.declined: We let your manager know you can't make it.
mine.cancelledNote: This shift was cancelled. You don't need to go.

availability.title: My availability
availability.lead: Tell whoever plans the shifts when you can or can't work. They'll see a warning if they schedule you outside it.
availability.emptyWeekly: Nothing set. Without entries, you can be scheduled any day.

response.title: Your shift
response.invalid: This link is no longer valid
response.invalidBody: The shift may have changed since this email was sent. Check your most recent email, or open My shifts in the app.
response.confirmDecline: Tell them I can't make it
response.doneDeclined: Thanks for letting them know. Your manager was notified.
response.currentDeclined: You told them you can't make this shift.
response.cancelled: This shift was cancelled. You don't need to go.

timesheet.title: My timesheet
timesheet.subtitle: Confirm the hours Northstack suggests, add anything missing, and send the week.
timesheet.subtitleOf: Read-only. Approve it, or send it back with a note.

banner.submitted: Sent. Waiting for approval; it can't be edited meanwhile.
banner.approved: Approved by {{name}}. This week is closed: to correct it, request an adjustment.
banner.returned: {{name}} sent it back: “{{note}}”. Fix it and send it again.

suggestions.title: Suggested from your activity
suggestions.lead: From your shifts, completed tasks, meetings and Google Calendar. Nothing is logged until you add it.

timesheet.emptyBody: Add the suggestions above or log time by hand.
timesheet.adjustedToast: Adjustment added to your current week

submit.title: Send this week?
submit.body: You logged {{total}}. Once sent you can't edit it unless it's sent back.

return.title: Send back
return.body: They'll be able to edit it again. Tell them what to fix.

reopen.title: Reopen this week
reopen.body: It goes back to open so it can be corrected and sent again. The reason is kept in the Activity Log.

adjust.title: Request an adjustment
adjust.body: This week is closed. The correction goes into your current week, is approved with it, and points back here.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Timesheets waiting for your decision. Open one to approve it or send it back.
approvals.nobody: You don't approve anyone's timesheet: nobody reports to you and your role doesn't include approving timesheets.

reports.title: Hours reports
reports.subtitle: Everything for the month: planned shifts (done, upcoming, unconfirmed) next to logged and approved hours.
reports.truncated: The CSV includes the first 5,000 entries; pick a shorter period for the rest.
reports.invoiceHint: Next you'll see the usual invoice form, filled in. Review it before sending. Northstack doesn't mark these hours as invoiced, so mind the period.
reports.emptyBody: Nothing planned or logged this month.

requests.title: Requests
requests.subtitle: Open-shift claims, hand-overs and swaps waiting for your approval.
requests.notScheduler: You don't schedule any location, so there's nothing to approve here.
requests.declineGiveHint: The shift stays with the person who handed it over and goes back to the available list.
requests.availableLead: Free places on open shifts and shifts colleagues are handing over.
requests.sentForApproval: Sent: waiting for a scheduler's approval
requests.giveBody: {{shift}} shows up as available to your colleagues. You stay on it until someone takes it and it's approved.
requests.giveHint: You'll get a notice when someone covers it.
requests.giveSent: Your shift is offered to your colleagues
requests.swapBody: Your shift {{shift}} for one of a colleague's, at the same location.
requests.noTargets: No colleague has a shift at this location in the next 30 days.
requests.swapHint: Your colleague accepts first; then it may need a scheduler's approval.
requests.openToClaim: Open to colleagues: anyone eligible can take a free place
requests.openToClaimHint: Free places show up in everyone's My shifts → Available to take.

clock.title: Clock in
clock.noShiftHere: You have no shift here now: it will be recorded as overtime.
clock.openElsewhere: You are still clocked in at {{location}}. Clock out there first.
clock.locationHint: This location checks your phone's position when you clock in.
clock.noPlace: Scan the QR at your location to clock in.
clock.noAppLocations: Clock in by scanning the QR at your location.
clock.awayFlag: Clocked in away from the location
clock.awayWarning: You clocked in away from the location: it's recorded, and your manager will see it.
clock.overtimeToast: Added to the schedule as overtime
clock.boardSubtitle: Who's in, who's missing and who already left, at each location. It updates when you open it.

review.autoClosed: Didn't clock out: closed at the shift's end
review.away: Clocked in away from the location

clock.locationOff: Clocking in is off at this location (Settings → Shifts → Clock-in).
clock.fixHint: The original times are kept next to the change, with your reason.

settings.title: Clock-in
settings.lead: How people clock in at each location: scanning the printed QR with their own phone, from the app, or both.
settings.growthOnly: Clocking in is part of the Growth plan.
settings.sheetStep: Scan this code with your phone's camera and tap Clock in.
settings.regenerated: New QR ready: print it again, the old sheet no longer works
settings.regenerateHint: If the sheet is copied or lost, make a new QR: the old one stops working.
settings.checkPosition: Check the phone's position when clocking in
settings.noPosition: Couldn't read your position. Allow location access and try again.
settings.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the print window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
